description: The document of an arrangement of clips on tracks: its clips, tracks and mixes, how far a clip reaches, where a MIDI clip's notes play, and what a track's volume and pan automation gives at a point of the song

exports.name: ClipAction
exports.summary: What a clip's menu does to it.

exports.name: Arranged
exports.summary: A clip laid on a track of an arrangement.

exports.name: TrackKind
exports.summary: What a track holds: audio clips, MIDI clips, or other tracks (a group, which holds no clip and plays what its tracks play).

exports.name: DeviceParameterKey
exports.summary: A parameter of a device on a track, by the device's id and the parameter's, at any depth of its racks: `device:<device>:<parameter>`.

exports.name: AutomatedParameter
exports.summary: What a track's automation can move: its volume, where it sits in the stereo field, or a parameter of one of its devices.

exports.name: deviceParameterKey
exports.summary: The key a device's parameter is automated under.

exports.name: parseDeviceParameter
exports.summary: The device and the parameter a key names, or null for the track's own volume and pan.

exports.name: macroIndex
exports.summary: The index of a rack's macro a parameter id names, `macro-1` to `macro-8`, or -1.

exports.name: TrackAutomation
exports.summary: A track's automation: for each parameter it moves, the points of its envelope across the whole arrangement, `x` from its start (0) to its end (1) and `y` the parameter's value from 0 to 1, with the curve of the segment leaving each point.

exports.name: TrackDevice
exports.summary: A device on a track's chain: which one (its stable id, such as `audioui.compressor`), its state, and whether it is switched on.

exports.name: RackChain
exports.summary: A chain of a rack: devices in series, and how loud and where it sits in what the rack sums.

exports.name: ChainZone
exports.summary: The notes a chain of an instrument rack plays: its keys, lowest to highest pitch, and its velocities, 0 to 1, both ends in.

exports.name: FULL_ZONE
exports.summary: The zone of a chain with none: every key, every velocity.

exports.name: inZone
exports.summary: Whether a chain plays a note of `pitch` struck as hard as `velocity`: inside its keys and its velocities.

exports.name: DrumVoice
exports.summary: The voices of the drum synthesis a pad can play.

exports.name: DrumSound
exports.summary: What a pad of a drum rack plays: a voice of the drum synthesis, or a recording, `tune` semitones from its own pitch, for `decay` seconds (a recording ends sooner when it is shorter).

exports.name: DrumPad
exports.summary: The note a chain of a drum rack answers, 0 to 127, and what it plays: the instrument at the head of its chain, such as a Drum Synth, or else `sound`.

exports.name: RackMapping
exports.summary: A parameter a macro turns: the device by its id, and the stretch of the parameter's travel the macro's turn covers, 0 to 1 of it.

exports.name: RackMacro
exports.summary: A knob of a rack, 0 to 1, that turns the parameters mapped to it together.

exports.name: Rack
exports.summary: Devices in parallel chains, summed, and eight macros over the devices inside.

exports.name: RACK_DEVICE
exports.summary: The id a rack's track device carries in place of a device of the library.

exports.name: MACRO_COUNT
exports.summary: How many macros a rack has.

exports.name: newRack
exports.summary: A rack with one chain holding `devices`, and its eight macros at rest, turning nothing.

exports.name: INSTRUMENT_RACK_DEVICE
exports.summary: The id an instrument rack's track device carries: an instrument whose chains each start with an instrument, played together by every note.

exports.name: DRUM_RACK_DEVICE
exports.summary: The id a drum rack's track device carries: an instrument whose chains are pads, each played by a note.

exports.name: DRUM_DECAYS
exports.summary: How long each voice of the drum synthesis rings by default, in seconds.

exports.name: SAMPLE_DECAY
exports.summary: How long a recording on a pad plays by default, in seconds, unless it ends sooner.

exports.name: newDrumRack
exports.summary: The kit a drum rack starts with: a kick on C2, a snare on D2 and a closed hat on F#2 (notes 36, 38 and 42), given the ids of their chains.

exports.name: padRecordings
exports.summary: The recordings the pads of `tracks`' drum racks play: what a project keeps with its clips' recordings.

exports.name: renamePadRecordings
exports.summary: A track whose drum racks' pads play the recordings `rename` gives for theirs: what a project opened under new recording ids needs.

exports.name: rackDevices
exports.summary: Every device inside a rack, down the racks within it.

exports.name: TrackColor
exports.summary: A track's color: an index into the colors the timeline offers, or a color of the user's own as a CSS hex such as `#3e63dd`.

exports.name: ArrangementTrack
exports.summary: A track of an arrangement.

exports.name: Mix
exports.summary: What a track's header sets: how loud it is, where it sits in the stereo field, and whether it is silenced or soloed.

exports.name: mixOf
exports.summary: What a track's header shows: its mix, over unity, with the track's own color.

exports.name: NEW_TRACK
exports.summary: Where files or a device dropped on the add-track button go: a track of their own.

exports.name: hasOutput
exports.summary: Whether a track has an output: a MIDI track with no instrument has none, so no volume, pan or sends (MIX-024).

exports.name: automatedParameter
exports.summary: The parameter a track's lane shows in automation mode: the one `shown`, or for a track with no output, whose volume and pan are gone (MIX-024), its first device parameter.

exports.name: clipReach
exports.summary: How far a clip can be stretched on the timeline: `undefined` when it loops, since it has no end then, as far as its warp stretches its source when it is warped, otherwise the length of its source.

exports.name: ClipPeaks
exports.summary: A recording's shape: an amplitude per slice from 0 to 1, or its lowest and highest samples, from -1 to 1.

exports.name: ClipReading
exports.summary: What reading a clip's recording takes: how it plays, not where it lies.

exports.name: clipPeakCount
exports.summary: How many slices `peaks` holds.

exports.name: clipFramePositions
exports.summary: Where each column edge of a stretch of a clip reads its recording, in frames of the source: `columns + 1` positions, fractional, from the first column's left edge to the last one's right edge, as a player reads it.

exports.name: ClipSegment
exports.summary: A stretch of a clip that reads its recording straight on: two times of the clip and the frames of the recording at them.

exports.name: clipSegments
exports.summary: The stretches of a clip between two times of it, in seconds from its start, each a straight read of its recording, as a DAW paints a region: one for a clip that plays on from its offset, one for each turn of its loop and each stretch between its warp markers.

exports.name: framesToRead
exports.summary: The frames to read for `positions`: from the first one any column touches to one past the last, within the source's `frames`.

exports.name: sampleBands
exports.summary: The lowest and highest sample each column covers, from -1 to 1, from the samples `values` read from frame `first`: the same bands as `clipWaveformBands`, sharper than the peaks allow.

exports.name: sampleLine
exports.summary: The sound as a line through its samples, for a zoom past one frame per column: the level at each column edge, interpolated between the samples `values` read from frame `first`, and each sample's place, as a fractional column, with its level.

exports.name: clipWaveform
exports.summary: What an audio clip shows of its recording across its length, `columns` amplitudes from 0 to 1, from the peaks of its source (`peaks`, spread evenly over `sourceLength`): the stretch it plays, folded round its loop, mirrored when reversed, stretched by its warp, as a player reads it.

exports.name: clipWaveformBands
exports.summary: The same read as `clipWaveform`, for each column the highest and the lowest it reaches, from -1 to 1: the sound as it is, lopsided where it is.

exports.name: TimeSelection
exports.summary: A stretch of time on some tracks: what a drag across bare lanes selects.

exports.name: Clipping
exports.summary: What a copy holds: how long it is, and the part of each clip in it, from 0, with how many tracks below the first one it came from.

exports.name: ClipScale
exports.summary: A MIDI clip's scale: a root (0 for C) and a scale's name, kept while it is off.

exports.name: ClipSwing
exports.summary: How a MIDI clip swings: `amount` from 0, straight, to 1, where an off-beat plays a third of a step late, as in a triplet; `division` is the step that swings, an eighth or a sixteenth.

exports.name: swungTime
exports.summary: Where `time` plays once swung on steps `step` long: the even steps stay, the odd ones are pushed late by `amount` of a third of a step, and the time between moves in a straight line, so no two notes ever change places.

exports.name: PlayedNote
exports.summary: Where a note of a MIDI clip plays in the arrangement, transposed with the clip.

exports.name: playedNotes
exports.summary: The notes a MIDI clip plays, where they play in the arrangement: the ones starting inside it, from where it starts in its source, and round its loop again and again when it has one.

exports.name: volumeGain
exports.summary: A volume envelope's value, 0…1, as a gain: 0 is silence, then -60 dB up to +6 dB along the way.

exports.name: volumeValue
exports.summary: The volume envelope's value, 0…1, that plays at `gain`: unity is 0 dB.

exports.name: panPosition
exports.summary: A pan envelope's value, 0…1, as a pan from -1 (left) to 1 (right).

exports.name: flatAutomation
exports.summary: Where a parameter's envelope starts when it is first drawn: the mix's value, flat.

exports.name: automationAt
exports.summary: An envelope's value at `x`, 0…1 of the arrangement: along the curve of the segment it falls in, the first point's value before it, the last's after.

exports.name: devicePositions
exports.summary: Where each automated device parameter of a track stands at `x`, 0…1 of the arrangement, as a position along its travel from 0 to 1, by device then parameter; one a change by hand has `overridden` plays as it is set.

exports.name: EDGE_FADE_SECONDS
exports.summary: The fade a clip laid down gets at each edge, in seconds: enough to take the click off a cut.

exports.name: withEdgeFades
exports.summary: A clip's fades as it is laid down: `EDGE_FADE_SECONDS` at each edge, or half its length when it is shorter.

exports.name: warpOnImport
exports.summary: A clip of a recording just brought in, warped in Beats so it plays in time at `tempo` (CLP-019): a short loop as that loop, any other on the first beat of each bar, starting on its first beat and as long as the whole recording plays.

exports.name: withCrossfades
exports.summary: A track's played clips with their crossfades: two that meet with fades of one length play through each other.

exports.name: rackWithMacros
exports.summary: A rack with each macro an envelope moves where `turned` has it, by its parameter id.

exports.name: withoutDeviceAutomation
exports.summary: A track's automation without the envelopes of the devices `gone`; the same one when it had none of theirs.

exports.name: mixAt
exports.summary: A track's gain and pan at `x`, 0…1 of the arrangement: its envelopes where it has them, its mix where it has none or where a change by hand has `overridden` them, until the automation is enabled again.

name: arrangement

exports.name: START_SECONDS
exports.summary: How far ahead a play is scheduled, so every part of the engine has heard of it before its first frame.

exports.name: MetronomeSettings
exports.summary: What the metronome does.

exports.name: createArrangementEngine
exports.summary: Plays an arrangement on a context: a clip player for each audio track, an instrument with a voice per held note for each MIDI track, each track's device chain, and the mixer they all go through, on one transport counted in frames of the audio clock.

exports.name: renderArrangement
exports.summary: Renders the arrangement's main output to a buffer, faster than real time, through the same engine that plays it: the same frames come out.

exports.name: renderTrackClips
exports.summary: What a track's clips play over `[from, to)` of the arrangement, and nothing else: their fades, gains and crossfades, without the track's devices, its mix, its automation or anything sent to it.

name: arrangement-engine

description: Exporting rendered sound to a file: the settings an export picks (format, bit depth or bitrate, a level left as it is, brought to its peak or to a loudness target) and exportSound, which measures, normalizes and encodes, saying how far it is

exports.name: ExportNormalize
exports.summary: How an export is brought to a level: left as it is, its loudest sample to 0 dBFS, or to a loudness in LUFS with its true peak at -1 dBTP at most.

exports.name: DEFAULT_EXPORT_SETTINGS
exports.summary: A 24-bit WAV, left at its level; an MP3 at 320 kbps once picked.

exports.name: ExportStage
exports.summary: What an export is doing, for a progress readout.

exports.name: exportSound
exports.summary: Turns rendered channels into a file of `settings`, saying how far it is through `onProgress`: first measured (the page waits about half a second a minute of stereo), then encoded in chunks.

exports.name: SPLICE
exports.summary: The crossfade of an edit's seam: half of it each side of the cut, in seconds.

exports.name: EDGE_EPS
exports.summary: How near an edge a pause has to start or end to be the silence at the start or the end of the sound, in seconds.

exports.name: SHRINK_GAP
exports.summary: The length a shrunk pause keeps, in seconds, as audio.js's `shrink` does by default.

exports.name: SHRINK_GAPS
exports.summary: The lengths a pause can be shrunk to: 0 takes it out whole.

exports.name: LEVEL_NUDGE
exports.summary: How far Louder and Quieter move the selection's level, in dB.

exports.name: MIN_DB
exports.summary: A selection's level range, in dB: silence at the bottom, a boost of 6 dB at the top.

exports.name: typing
exports.summary: Whether a key went to a field you type in, where its keys are its own.

exports.name: removing
exports.summary: Taking the time from `from` to `to` out, the time after it moving in: nothing when it is empty.

exports.name: splice
exports.summary: The crossfade of an edit's seam at `at`, in a sound `length` long: the clip that ends there and the one that starts there play through each other.

exports.name: StretchShape
exports.summary: What fades and level on a selection set: the fades at its two ends, their curves, and its level in dB.

exports.name: near
exports.summary: Two times the same, to the frame.

exports.name: shapeOf
exports.summary: What the selection has now: the shape of the one clip it covers exactly, or none.

exports.name: pieceOf
exports.summary: A clip's piece from `from` to `to` on the timeline, the source following, with no fades of its own.

exports.name: shapeStretch
exports.summary: The track's clips with the stretch from `from` to `to` cut out of them as clips of their own, the shape on those: the fade-in on the first, the fade-out on the last, the level on all.

exports.summary: What the planner needs of a recording streamed on this page: its rate and length; nothing for one decoded in memory.

exports.summary: Lets a recording go from a context's players, once no clip plays it.
